visualCharacteristics.purpose: Company history timeline as period tabs
visualCharacteristics.description: White-on-navy tab bar of period labels (underlined active tab, sideways scrolling when they do not fit) above the active period's panel: optional period title, then subtitle and text beside a 353px image (stacked on phones, halves from 768px, a 1024px centred panel from 1024px). ARIA tablist with arrow-key, Home and End navigation. Meant for a dark section.

contentPattern.structure: One row per period: tab label | text (optional title heading, subtitle heading, paragraphs or list) | image (optional second image = mobile crop)

reuseGuidance: Use for a few labelled periods or topics that each show text beside one image. Two headings at the top of the text cell: the first becomes the full-width panel title. Place the block in a dark section; its colours assume a navy background.
